verdict: MECM site upgrade is stuck at the `Upgrade ConfigMgr Database` step. Another session holds a blocking lock on the CM database, preventing the schema update from progressing.
fix: Find the blocker: `SELECT req.session_id, req.blocking_session_id, req.wait_type, req.wait_resource, t.text FROM sys.dm_exec_requests req CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(req.sql_handle) t WHERE req.blocking_session_id > 0`. Identify the blocking app (often a third-party ITSM integration, a SQL trace, or a stuck report query). Stop it or `KILL <session_id>` as a sysadmin. The upgrade will resume automatically.
